summary: Swaps a3 bytes between the buffers a1 and a2 in-place, element by element, advancing both pointers. No-op when the pointers are equal or a3 is zero. Returns the advanced a1 pointer (result starts at a1 and is incremented a3 times, so on the no-op path it equals a1). Used by sub_5890AA and sub_5891FE to exchange equal-sized byte blocks.

operations.description: Initialize result = a1 and v4 = a2; result doubles as the advancing source pointer and return value.
Only perform the swap when a1 != a2 and a3 is non-zero.
Repeat a3 times: swap one byte (v6 = *result, *result++ = *v4, *v4++ = v6), decrementing v5 until zero.
Return result, the a1 pointer advanced by a3 bytes.
